source_cause: Current export reachable only from vk_device_struct destructor.

Device is retained in vk_instance.devices and its own buffer_type.context holds a strong shared_ptr to the same device; no backend-free deletion of this context releases that ownership. Data buffer release is therefore not device destruction or cache export.

ggml_backend_vk_free already calls ggml_vk_cleanup, which discards unsubmitted context, synchronizes pending submissions and cleans graph/context resources, then deletes backend context. It currently does not persist the live cache.
